The policy this creates is EMPTY — no title, no description. It is a shell
that steps 2 and 3 populate. An agent that creates without titling leaves an
untitled orphan someone has to find and clean up by hand, so the prompt
requires the pair to complete together.
owner_id is a NUMERIC Alation user id, not an email. Resolve it with the
Get Users base tool, or `agentkit userid <email>`. Never guess it.
name: Create Blank Policy
description: Create a single new, empty business policy in Alation owned by the given user, and return its numeric id and url. The policy is created with NO title and NO description — it is an empty shell that must be populated by Set Policy Title and Set Policy Description before it is usable. Call once per policy. There is no undo through these tools, so only call it for a policy the user has explicitly approved.

owner_id.description: Numeric Alation user id that will own the policy, e.g. 1. This is the user id, not an email address or username. If the user gives a name or email, resolve it first — never guess.
